property_summary: For any caller address that is a Bank-like contract returning keccak256("Nu Token") from supportsToken(), calling airDrop() always succeeds and sets tokenBalance[caller]==20 on the reference; the mutant requires a different literal and therefore will fail (revert) when the caller is such an honest Bank contract.
change_summary: Alter supportsToken to require a different literal ("Bad Token"), causing the supportsToken check to fail for the original Bank and preventing airDrop from crediting tokens.
